params.prompt: Edit the FIRST image (a photo of a man). Keep him exactly the same person: the same face shape, the same GREEN eyes, the same dark curly shoulder-length hair, the same skin, the same beige knit cardigan over a dark T-shirt, the same room with the blue light on the wall and the wooden door, the same camera framing and lighting. Change ONLY his facial expression to match the man in the SECOND image: an intense, skeptical, piercing stare straight into the camera lens, brows pulled down and slightly together, eyes narrowed a little, lips pressed firmly closed, jaw set, chin slightly lowered, head facing the camera squarely. Also remove the black microphone and its boom arm from the bottom of the frame and fill in his cardigan and shirt naturally where they were. Photoreal, sharp focus on his eyes, no text.
